name: Codex CLI
description: OpenAI's coding agent that runs locally in the terminal, reading, editing and running code in your repository.
whatItDoes: Codex CLI works on software tasks inside a local project: explaining code, implementing changes, running commands and tests. Users sign in with a ChatGPT plan or use an API key.
howItWorks: A Rust binary runs the agent loop against OpenAI models, executing shell commands and file edits under sandboxing and approval policies. It is also available through IDE extensions and a desktop app.

requirements.name: ChatGPT account or OpenAI API key
requirements.description: Sign-in with a ChatGPT plan, or API key usage
